decision_authority.policy: MRX continuous quality-gated publication and two-image article creative directive

title: Selling Mineral Rights: Valuation Factors Without Obligation
findings: Complete current MDX SHA-256 is a38e73e29b65c978f57ff784b72b1fa979034411318ed43511053a1d0d127784; all 8 declared sources passed live access review.

MRX claims remain bounded to its current FAQ, booking, methodology, Privacy Policy, and Terms of Use; NIST remains a voluntary organizational privacy-risk framework; EIA remains dated public data series; and IRS claims remain general disposition and record distinctions.

The article uses no fabricated owners, buyers, deeds, privacy rights, permissions, prices, factor weights, multiples, acreage, ownership decimals, production, reserves, development events, tax results, offers, testimonials, or owner-specific title, legal, privacy, tax, accounting, engineering, appraisal, investment, or transaction conclusions.

sources_inspected.label: Mineral Rights Xchange, Frequently Asked Questions (accessed 2026-08-12)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The current MRX FAQ states that its review is a free, no-obligation directional underwriter assessment, not a certified valuation, and states its no-pressure and potential-buyer disclosure boundaries.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the FAQ only for MRX’s current first-party review policy and limitations; it does not convert “no obligation” into a universal legal term, promise a result, or interpret a separate agreement.

sources_inspected.label: Mineral Rights Xchange, Book a Free Underwriter Review (accessed 2026-08-12)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The current MRX booking page describes a confidential review path with no card and no obligation while preserving separate intake and later decision steps.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the booking page only for the current first-party intake description; it does not promise eligibility, completion timing, a range, an offer, payment, sale, or closing.

sources_inspected.label: Mineral Rights Xchange, Published DCF Methodology (accessed 2026-08-12)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The current MRX methodology identifies production history, decline context, operator and development evidence, royalty terms, commodity assumptions, discounting, title and acreage, and offer terms as dated inputs to a directional range with assumptions stated.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the methodology to preserve the directional-range, stated-assumption, offer-separation, and professional boundaries while owning the no-obligation permission journey; it does not calculate a property-specific value, prove title or reserves, promise an outcome, or recommend a transaction.

sources_inspected.label: Mineral Rights Xchange, Privacy Policy (accessed 2026-08-12)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The current MRX Privacy Policy describes first-party information collection, use, sharing, retention, export, deletion, and related choices and exceptions.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article points readers to the policy as controlling and uses it only to require purpose-specific record handling; it does not expand the policy, guarantee deletion, or state an owner-specific privacy right or compliance result.

sources_inspected.label: Mineral Rights Xchange, Terms of Use (accessed 2026-08-12)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The current MRX Terms of Use govern the service and state educational, non-certified, non-title, and non-reserves boundaries alongside other applicable terms.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article preserves the terms as controlling and does not interpret enforceability, obligations, rights, remedies, or a particular agreement.

sources_inspected.label: National Institute of Standards and Technology, Privacy Framework (accessed 2026-08-12)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The NIST Privacy Framework is a voluntary, risk- and outcome-based organizational tool for identifying and managing privacy risk from data processing.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses NIST only for the general discipline of connecting processing to a stated purpose and considering privacy risk; it does not treat the framework as law, certification, or proof of an owner-specific right or MRX compliance result.

sources_inspected.label: U.S. Energy Information Administration, Natural Gas Data (accessed 2026-08-12)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The current EIA natural-gas data directory publishes price, production, reserves, drilling, supply, and other series with stated geographic scopes, frequencies, and release dates that differ by dataset.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses EIA only to require a named series, retrieval date, frequency, and geography; it does not treat an EIA series as the realized price, production history, reserves, forecast, or value of a specific mineral interest.

sources_inspected.label: Internal Revenue Service, Publication 544, Sales and Other Dispositions of Assets (accessed 2026-08-12)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: IRS Publication 544 explains that gain or loss and tax treatment for a sale or other disposition depend on the property and transaction facts and on adjusted basis and amount realized.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the publication only to require preservation of disposition- and basis-relevant records and a transaction-specific tax handoff; it does not classify the owner’s asset, calculate basis, gain, loss, liability, choose a form or election, or state an owner-specific tax result.
